title: The Birth of Jesus Christ
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child retells the wise men (Matthew 2:1-12) and names Nazareth as Jesus' hometown, Bethlehem as his birthplace.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the gifts of the wise men.
floor.question: Name one gift the wise men gave Jesus.

representations: a simple map with Bethlehem and Nazareth
contexts: following directions to a new place
a family moving to a new town

board.do: Wait for the child to say Jesus grew up there.
Write: born in Bethlehem, grew up in Nazareth.

misconceptions.ask: Which town was Jesus' hometown, where he grew up?
misconceptions.repair: Show two towns on a map: born in Bethlehem, grew up in Nazareth (Matthew 2:23).

listen_for: In the stable on the night he was born
misconceptions.ask: Where did the wise men find Jesus, according to Matthew 2:11?
misconceptions.repair: Read Matthew 2:11: they came to the house. Shepherds came on the birth night (Luke 2).

listen_for: Yes, three, and gives their names
misconceptions.ask: Does Matthew say how many wise men came?
misconceptions.repair: Read Matthew 2:1, 11 and count the gifts, not the men.

misconceptions.ask: Why did the wise men go home another way?
misconceptions.repair: Read Matthew 2:12. Herod did not mean what he said.
